headlines.text: Epoch 0 opens. The Store is stocked and the assembly sits tonight.
An election opens for the office of coordinator: 3 seats, closing at the end of day 0. Any citizen may stand.
founder-1 joins the Commune. The Store is theirs to draw from and the norm theirs to meet.
wage-maximiser-1 joins the Commune. The Store is theirs to draw from and the norm theirs to meet.
speculator-1 joins the Commune. The Store is theirs to draw from and the norm theirs to meet.
saver-1 joins the Commune. The Store is theirs to draw from and the norm theirs to meet.
slacker-1 joins the Commune. The Store is theirs to draw from and the norm theirs to meet.
borrower-1 joins the Commune. The Store is theirs to draw from and the norm theirs to meet.
landlord-1 joins the Commune. The Store is theirs to draw from and the norm theirs to meet.
rule-prober-1 joins the Commune. The Store is theirs to draw from and the norm theirs to meet.
founder-1 moves before the assembly: Seven hours. The vote closes at the end of day 0.
wage-maximiser-1 moves before the assembly: Honor founder-1. The vote closes at the end of day 0.
founder-1 withdraws from the coordinator election.
